newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Liquidity pushes Saudi riyal rates down.
newsitem.headline: Liquidity pushes Saudi riyal rates down.

text.p: Higher liquidity pushed most Saudi interbank deposit rates down between 1/16 and 1/8 point in active trade but the spot Saudi riyal against the dollar was unchanged, dealers in the kingdom said on Thursday.
They said activity focused on the swap market.
Three, six and one-year maturities dropped 1/8 point to 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and 5-15/16, 13/16 percent respectively.
The spot riyal was unchanged at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
